method: Conservative acceptance-gate completion: equal weight within each fixed checklist; percentage=100*fully evidenced achieved gates/total gates. Partial, source-only, conditional, unexecuted, unknown and unverified work earns no fractional gate credit. Counts describe acceptance gates, not effort, elapsed time, ETA or universal correctness.

stage_name: Source integration, fit and complete-control qualification
update_policy: Preserve this denominator and criteria for this stage and overall goal. Append timestamped reports and link exact newly qualifying evidence. Revoke credit if evidence no longer applies. Source case counts and narrower accepted outcomes are reported separately. If the stage completes, adopt a new versioned checklist derived from the next PLAN stage and explicitly report the stage transition; never silently change denominators or move unfulfilled requirements.
